Ten minutes later, my mom called up and said that a plane hit the World Trade Center. I always thought that terrorists were going to try and attack the WTC again, but my initial thought was that it was just a small plane. A week or two before 9/11, some French eco-activist had parachuted out of a plane or helicopter and landed on the Statue of Liberty. My initial thought was that this activist came back again but this time something went wrong.

A few minutes later, mom called again and said another plane hit the second tower.

By that time, we had arrived at the foundry and I spent the next few hours in a boat, with my phone in the car. One of my co-workers was a spotter on shore and she would relay information she heard on the radio each time we got within ear shot of her (it was a big pond). When we were done collecting samples, I got back to shore and checked my phone. There were several messages from my mom with updates, including the report of a car bomb at the State Department which later proved to be false. Although the radio reports had said that the towers had fallen, not being able to see it on a screen, we wondered how many floors were left, being unable to comprehend that they were totally gone. It wasn't until late evening that I finally saw pictures of what had happened.

We were in a small Midwestern town on that day, the kind of town that has exactly one Chinese restaurant. We had lunch at that restaurant and I always remember the look of dread and fear in the Chinese host's face and eyes when he greeted us and asked us if we had heard the news.

One of my co-workers, Javier, was an ex-Marine. His unit was scheduled to be sent to Lebanon back in 1983 to replace a unit that was already there. However, a terrorist attack killed 241 US soldiers as well as 58 French soldiers and other civilians. Most of the US soliders killed were marines and Javier even claimed to know some of those that were killed. Javier and I drove home at the end of the day and he was very pissed off at Muslims for the whole two-hour ride. If he had seen a Muslim walking along the side of the road, I am sure he would have just ran him down.
